prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Repair text hierarchy in a Mac/iPhone finance report. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platforms: iOS/macOS. Body uses one thin 9 pt custom font, headings are images and values clip under larger text. Tabular financial figures shift horizontally as they update; all emphasis is all-caps paragraphs.

criteria.task_completion: Patch platform-appropriate styles/hierarchy, actual scalable text, stable numeric alignment and readable emphasis with localized and enlarged-text checks; preserve content rather than shrinking it.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the typography guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch platform-appropriate styles/hierarchy, actual scalable text, stable numeric alignment and readable emphasis with localized and enlarged-text checks; preserve content rather than shrinking it.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Patch platform-appropriate styles/hierarchy, actual scalable text, stable numeric alignment and readable emphasis with localized and enlarged-text checks; preserve content rather than shrinking it.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
